title: Jubilant Norwegian Galangal Skewers
description: A Whole30-friendly Norwegian dish featuring galangal and a mustardy flavor, perfect for a crowd, this recipe uses spherification to add a unique aerated texture.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender, combine chopped galangal, coconut milk, yellow mustard, salt, and black pepper, and blend until smooth.
Thread the beef cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Brush the galangal mixture onto the beef cubes.
In a small bowl, mix the sodium alginate with water to create a spherification bath.
Drop the skewers into the spherification bath and let them sit for 30 seconds to create a unique aerated texture.
Remove the skewers from the bath and place them on the grill.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the beef is cooked through.
Brush the coconut oil onto the skewers during the last minute of grilling.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
